name: WoL Passkey
description: A lightweight Wake-on-LAN web interface with passkey login (WebAuthn). Flat-file PHP with no database, designed for phones: tap a tile to send the magic packet, and see at a glance which devices are already online.

notes.text: A random setup key is generated during installation. Read it with `grep setup_key /opt/wol-passkey/config.php`, then open `/setup.php` once to set the login password.
Passkey (WebAuthn) registration requires a secure context. Over plain http://IP only the password login works - put the container behind a reverse proxy with TLS and a hostname to use passkeys.
The broadcast address is derived from the container's own subnet. Magic packets only reach devices in that subnet; adjust $networkbroadcast in config.php if your targets live elsewhere.
